title: Kevin Viveros scores two goals and leads the Brazilian Serie A scoring chart
seoTitle: Kevin Viveros scores twice, tops Brazil Serie A scoring
subtitle: In a match against Santos, the Colombian striker scored at the 14th and 26th minutes, raising his total to 14 goals.
excerpt: Kevin Viveros, 26, netted two goals against Santos, moving Athletico Paranaense to third place and taking the lead in the Brazilian Serie A top scorer race.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 9, 2026, Colombian striker Kevin Viveros experienced his best moment in Brazilian football by scoring two goals in Athletico Paranaense's victory over Santos. At 26 years old, Viveros already stands out as the team's main offensive reference.

Viveros shines at Athletico Paranaense

The player, born in Buenaventura, was part of the club's starting lineup, known as “Furacão”, in the match held at Vila Belmiro. The duel took place without Neymar Jr., who was absent due to a suspension.

The two goals against Santos

Viveros opened the scoring at the 14th minute, capitalizing on a rebound inside the box and finishing with the typical striker's execution. Still in the first half, at the 26th minute, he received the ball on a counter‑attack and, as if “turning on the engine”, struck again, extending the lead to 2‑0.

Striker's reaction after the match

At the end of the match, the Colombian thanked the fans, said “when things go well, God strengthens me” and highlighted that the victory was “unexplainable”, indicating that the squad is ready for great achievements.

Position in the top scorer ranking

With the two goals, Viveros reached 14 goals in the Brazilian league, taking the lead in the Brazilian Championship scoring chart. He surpasses Pedro of Flamengo, who has 12 goals.

Impact on the Serie A table

The win kept Athletico Paranaense in third place with 40 points, two behind Flamengo, which occupies second, and eight behind leaders Palmeiras. Viveros' performance was also mentioned as a possible factor for a call‑up to the Colombian national team for friendlies against Peru and Mexico scheduled for September.

With information from El Colombiano.
